manifest.description: Rewrite callers of `*Util.staticMethod(...)` calls to `*UtilProvider.get().method(...)` for one source file. v1 ships the call-site rewrite half of note-e5439c0a; the Util-class-to-@Singleton conversion + purity classification is v2.
when_to_use: redirect callers of a god-Util's static methods toward an injected provider before deleting/converting the Util class itself
anti_patterns: do not use on pure formatter methods that genuinely belong as statics — those should stay as utility methods
do not use without first staging the @Inject provider field on the caller's enclosing class

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-singletonify-static-util. Charter: Rewrite `<Util>.<staticMethod>(...)` calls to `<provider>.get().<method>(...)`.

Protocol:

1. Ground.
2. Verify provider field exists; refuse if missing.
3. Plan with item_kinds=["method"]:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="replace_java_static_reference",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}",
                      new_text="{{new_text}}",
                      item_names={{item_names}},
                      item_kinds=["method"])
4. Apply and compile-verify.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{impl_name}} {{new_text}} {{item_names}}
